projects.title: Coastal House Renovation
projects.description: A full coastal home renovation transforming every key space. The project included a kitchen rebuild with custom sage cabinetry and ocean views, two tiled bathrooms with premium fixtures, and a hardwood deck with plunge pool and glass balustrade.

projects.title: Coastal Family Home
projects.description: A four-bedroom coastal home with spotted gum flooring, custom cabinetry throughout and a north-facing deck to maximise the outlook. Delivered on time and on budget over a seven-month build.

projects.title: Hardwood Entertainer's Deck
projects.description: A 65m² hardwood deck with integrated bench seating, a built-in planter border and a feature pergola. Built for the coastal environment with stainless steel fixings and premium hardwood throughout.

projects.title: Kitchen & Laundry Overhaul
projects.description: A full kitchen gut and rebuild — custom cabinetry with soft-close drawers, stone benchtops and a generous island bench. The laundry was fully reconfigured at the same time.

projects.title: Alfresco & Pergola
projects.description: An alfresco entertaining space with an attached pergola, feature lighting and a custom outdoor kitchen bench, engineered to complement the existing roofline and blend seamlessly into the backyard.
